name: Kronova Asset Intelligence Platform
summary: Open-source Next.js frontend for orchestrating RWA tokenization and AI agent workflows with a 44-field asset schema.
description: An open-source Next.js orchestration layer for real-world-asset (RWA) tokenization and multi-agent AI workflows, shipping a 44-field asset schema, integrated AI tools and an OAuth 2.1 MCP server. The repo runs locally as a sandbox; legally binding settlement and secure execution go through the proprietary AetherNet QUAS API under an enterprise key.
contains: Next.js orchestration frontend for RWA tokenization and AI agent workflows
OAuth 2.1 MCP server and a library of integrated AI tools
runs locally as a free sandbox
production settlement via the proprietary AetherNet QUAS API (Canton smart contracts)
